records.context: The spaCR store: Parquet tables, Zarr extracted image regions and one DuckDB catalog.
records.label: spacr.store#0
records.source: The spaCR store: Parquet tables, Zarr crops and one DuckDB catalog.
records.translation: spaCR 存储：Parquet 表、Zarr 裁剪图和一个 DuckDB 目录。

records.context:
A project folder holds one table per object class under ``tables//plate=

/well=/part-.parquet``, one extracted image region store per microplate sample position under ``crops/plate=

/well=.zarr`` and the catalog ``spacr.duckdb``, which registers every file with its row count and sha256 and defines one view per table over the registered files only.
records.label: spacr.store#1
records.source:
A project folder holds one table per object class under ``tables//plate=

/well=/part-.parquet``, one crop store per well under ``crops/plate=

/well=.zarr`` and the catalog ``spacr.duckdb``, which registers every file with its row count and sha256 and defines one view per table over the registered files only.
records.translation:
项目文件夹中，每个对象类别一个表，位于 ``tables//plate=

/well=/part-.parquet``；每个孔一个裁剪图存储，位于 ``crops/plate=

/well=.zarr``；以及目录 ``spacr.duckdb``，它登记每个文件及其行数和 sha256，并为每个表定义一个仅覆盖已登记文件的视图。

records.context: Each microplate sample position writes its own files with :func:`write_part` (a temporary name, an atomic rename, then a manifest), so microplate sample positions write in parallel without a lock. :func:`register` adds every waiting manifest to the catalog in one transaction. :func:`open` reads the registry and answers queries through an in-memory DuckDB, so a reader never holds the catalog. A folder holding only an older ``measurements.db`` opens through the same API.
records.label: spacr.store#2
records.source: Each well writes its own files with :func:`write_part` (a temporary name, an atomic rename, then a manifest), so wells write in parallel without a lock. :func:`register` adds every waiting manifest to the catalog in one transaction. :func:`open` reads the registry and answers queries through an in-memory DuckDB, so a reader never holds the catalog. A folder holding only an older ``measurements.db`` opens through the same API.
records.translation: 每个孔用 :func:`write_part` 写入自己的文件（先使用临时名称，再原子重命名，然后写入清单），因此各孔无需加锁即可并行写入。:func:`register` 在一个事务中将所有等待中的清单加入目录。:func:`open` 读取登记表，并通过内存中的 DuckDB 响应查询，因此读取方从不占用目录。仅包含较旧 ``measurements.db`` 的文件夹也可通过同一 API 打开。

records.context:
The rows are sorted by ``sort_by`` and written under a temporary name, flushed and renamed into ``tables//plate=

/well=/``. The extracted image regions go to ``crops/plate=

/well=.zarr`` in the same row order and each row gets ``crop_store`` and ``crop_index``. The manifest in ``_pending/`` is written last; nothing is visible to readers until :func:`register` adds it to the catalog.
records.label: spacr.store.write_part#1
records.source:
The rows are sorted by ``sort_by`` and written under a temporary name, flushed and renamed into ``tables//plate=

/well=/``. The crops go to ``crops/plate=

/well=.zarr`` in the same row order and each row gets ``crop_store`` and ``crop_index``. The manifest in ``_pending/`` is written last; nothing is visible to readers until :func:`register` adds it to the catalog.
records.translation:
行按 ``sort_by`` 排序，以临时名称写入，刷新后重命名到 ``tables//plate=

/well=/``。裁剪图按相同的行顺序写入 ``crops/plate=

/well=.zarr``，每行获得 ``crop_store`` 和 ``crop_index``。``_pending/`` 中的清单最后写入；在 :func:`register` 将其加入目录之前，读取方看不到任何内容。
